classifier.group_field_boundary: Source classifier reads Info.cfg Group if present, writes ground_truth_group and ground_truth_match alongside predicted_group. This is not an independent validation result or proof of isolation.
classifier.input_paths: Explicit paired ED/ES segmentations, multi-frame segmentation directory, or single segmentation path. Does not read feature_table_path.
classifier.measurements: ACDC source labels 1 RV, 2 myocardium, 3 LV; voxel count x spacing product / 1000 for volumes ml; LV/RV EF = (EDV-ESV)/EDV x 100 where EDV positive; myocardial thickness/mass and local contraction proxy. No case metrics retained.
classifier.phase_resolution: Explicit 1-based phase arguments, then Info.cfg ED/ES, then LV-volume extrema where frames available; single phase returns index 0 for both.
classifier.review_flag: needs_vlm_review is a source rule flag, not clinical adjudication.

conditional_branch: Raw cine H5 requires reconstruction to NIfTI; cine NIfTI enters segmentation directly. Reconstruction is not a required-success stage.
feature_dependency: ROI-feature CSV and classifier JSON are parallel outputs from segmentation; classifier computes from masks, not that CSV.

phase_modes.behavior: No temporal curve; one frame may serve as both ED and ES.
phase_modes.label: One 3D phase

phase_modes.behavior: 1-based phase values select source frames; classifier records zero-based indices.
phase_modes.label: 4D with valid Info.cfg ED/ES

phase_modes.behavior: Segment all frames by default; classifier may use LV-volume extrema.
phase_modes.label: 4D without valid ED/ES

report: Pinned report tool reads case_state and available artifacts and writes report JSON. Its content is answer-owned output, not an independent clinical reference.

segmentation.label_role: Source output convention, not verified expert truth.
segmentation.nifti_3d: Single phase, no temporal curve implied.
segmentation.nifti_4d: Split to 3D frames. Default ED/ES-only uses valid 1-based Info.cfg values; if none valid, processes all frames.
segmentation.raw_h5: Task goal conditionally reconstructs H5 to NIfTI; no reconstruction among required stage-success keys. Retained pinned tree has no separately named cardiac-H5 reconstruction tool source, so no loader shape/conversion behavior is asserted. No conversion executed.
